verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated Access Reviews solution with pre-built content and guided workflows that automates the access review process (vanta-docs-21, vanta-docs-67, vanta-docs-83, vanta-docs-37). That is the product's own capability for this story, but the evidence does not show the specific mechanics the story asks for. missing for 10: evidence of periodic or recurring review scheduling, reviews spanning connected app integrations, in-app reviewer sign-off, the completed review artifact landing automatically in the evidence library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
